description: Implementation class for BankingService providing CRUD operations, monetary transactions, and account management. It interacts with repositories, handles transaction logic, and enforces business rules for a banking application.

classes.name: BankingServiceImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the BankingService interface, providing CRUD operations and transaction management for banking accounts and customers.

methods.name: createCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the repository and returns the customer details.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Creates a new bank account linked to a customer.

methods.name: getAccount
methods.description: Retrieves account information by account ID.

methods.name: deposit
methods.description: Deposits a specified amount into an account and records the transaction.

methods.name: withdraw
methods.description: Withdraws a specified amount from an account if sufficient funds exist, and records the transaction.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Transfers funds between two accounts after validation, recording both out and in transactions.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for a specific account.

methods.name: getBalance
methods.description: Returns the current balance of an account.

methods.name: getBalancesForCustomer
methods.description: Returns a list of balances for all accounts associated with a customer.
